U_0x0014C2: Unit 3 of the R Series <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-3 POWERED." A light command-use, long-range unit with <T-LINK System> remote weapons and top detection/intel gathering. Only Psychodrivers can pilot it; in practice it's Capt. Aya Kobayashi's machine. Plus parts with a T-LINK Flight System make it the heavy bomber R-3 Powered.
U_0x001802: Unit 1 of the RW Series <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-GUN." Originally a high-output heavy metal particle cannon, miniaturized for a purpose and given <Personal Trooper> transformation to fight solo. Its <Tronium> Engine beats R-2's, with output/firepower above other R Series units, though unstable. Effectively the 4th R Series unit but never named "R-4," secretly developed at <Mao Industries> on the Moon under codename "ARGAN." With plus parts like the back-mounted High Twin Launcher it becomes R-GUN Powered. After the <L5 Campaign>, an improved <T-LINK System> enabled T-LINK Twin Contact with R-3.
U_0x001D49: A prototype all-purpose decisive-strike <Personal Trooper> of the <SRX Project>, formed from R-1, R-2 Powered, and R-3 Powered. Officially "SUPER ROBOT X-TYPE." Concept: "a humanoid weapon combining traits of a special humanoid mobile weapon (<S.Unit>/Super Robot) and a <Personal Trooper>, able to shift the battle as one unit or three." The <SRX Project> made it a combiner where three 20m-class <Personal Trooper>s unite into a 50m-class <S.Unit>. Splitting or combining as needed gives flexibility: vs many weak foes, or coordinating with other <Personal Trooper>s, units act separately; vs a few strong foes they combine to focus the R Series' power. Attack power is superb, but the <Tronium> Engine is hard to regulate, and combat requires a Telekinetic Field held via the <T-LINK System> to sustain combination, straining the user badly; this limits combinations per sortie and combat time.
U_0x0045EE: A humanoid mobile weapon of the Machinery Children. A Mass-Prod Huckebein Mk-II remade with <Machine Cell> for new form and higher specs. Mounts the <Geim System> and remote weapons; its <Machine Cell> frame self-repairs.
U_0x0047B4: A special anti-alien humanoid mobile weapon from the <Tesla Leicht Institute> for the Earth Sphere Defense Committee. Built around physical attack via sheer mass, its size/shape aim to intimidate intelligent foes. Made to fight foes beyond a <Personal Trooper>, with exceptional output and attack power. Its huge blade, "Type-0 Zankantou," can cleave battleship-class objects in two. High-thrust boosters and trim balancers on its back enable free sword combat, and TGC joints cut load via gravity-controlled inertial mass. After the <Inspector Incident>, a refit gave it a plasma reactor.
U_0x0054BB: Third unit (SRG-03-3) of the newest Grungusts, from the <Tesla Leicht Institute> under the <SRX Project>, unfrozen after the <L5 Campaign>. Based on the Grungust (Type-1) and specialized for melee, with the series' highest output and attack power. Splits into the G-Raptor fighter (upper body) and G-Bison tank (lower body), one pilot each. After the <Inspector Incident>, it gained the <T-LINK System>, a <Tesla Drive>, and the Type-3 Shishioh Blade (<S.Unit>-size).
U_0x007810: A <Personal Trooper> from <Mao Industries>. A close-combat unit inheriting Alt Eisen's concept, usually paired with the artillery-type Wild Falken. Uses no <EOT>, carrying solid-round short/mid-range weapons, and the GII frame rather than R-1/Huckebein H frame. A high-output <Tesla Drive> allows solo flight under gravity; purging Jacket Armor shifts it to high-mobility mode. Designed by Dr. Marion Radom. One other unit of this type exists.
U_0x00827E:
The R-Blade is <Mao Industries>' simplified mass-production prototype <Personal Trooper> based on R-1. It omits R-1's flight transform and <T-LINK System> (telekinesis sensor-amp) but performs well.
The R-Blade Custom refits prototype 3 for close combat, adding a <Tesla Drive>, Split Beam Cannon, and the Wild Wurger's jacket armor.
